system.description:
You move in to finish off your enemy with a powerful debilitating strike.

Make a melee taijutsu attack. On a hit you deal your [Unarmed damage] and the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save the target is stricken with a crippling affliction causing them to be unable to take the Dash, Dodge, Disengage, Help or Ready Action for the next minute.

An affected creature can make spend an action to make a Constitution ability check vs your Taijutsu save DC to end this effect early.

Finisher: you make three melee taijutsu attacks. If all three attacks are successful, then the target immediately fails their saving throw.
